ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to Gies Marketing and Management students on Monday, November 15, 2021 and to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 22, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
